run_config_parser_with_args: run config_parser with a list of command line arguments to parse training options
run_config_parser_from_cli: run config_parser to parse command line arguments for the dynamic NeRF training pipeline
create_training_config: create a training configuration by calling config_parser with custom learning rate and iteration arguments
create_rendering_config: create a rendering configuration by calling config_parser with render_only and render_test flags enabled
create_model_config: create a model configuration by calling config_parser with model_name and volume decomposition arguments
